nodes.label: security-patch Scope
nodes.rationale: Minimal depth, 10 of 32, skeleton off. Skips the whole design ceremony because the change is targeted, but unlike bugfix keeps deployment-pipeline and deployment-execution EXECUTE, since a patch that never deploys does not close the vulnerability. requirements-analysis runs to give an auditable statement of the vulnerability and its remediation criteria, and nfr-requirements runs to record the security constraint.
